title: Design a search system for an e-commerce catalog.
description: Use Elasticsearch, indexing pipelines, and caching for fast product search.

data.text: **Question:** Design a search system for an e-commerce catalog.
Index products in Elasticsearch, sync via CDC or background jobs, cache frequent queries, and support faceted filtering and autocomplete.

items: Data source: product database or event stream
Sync: Debezium CDC or scheduled ETL jobs
Index: Elasticsearch with analyzers for text, numbers, and categories
Query: full-text, fuzzy, faceted filters, sorting
Cache: Redis for hot queries and autocomplete
Not tuning analyzers for product search
How do you handle typos in search?
How do you rank results by relevance?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Sync changes via CDC or ETL
